paper.title: Beyond Markets and States: Polycentric Governance of Complex Economic Systems
paper.zh_title: 超越市场与国家：复杂经济系统的多中心治理
paper.author: Elinor Ostrom
paper.description: 森林、渔场与灌溉系统由使用者共同管理时，人们怎样建立可持续的合作规则？
paper.note: 本站双语导读，非原文全文或逐句翻译。共同管理能否成功取决于规则、监督和情境，不意味着所有公共资源都会被自动保护。
paper.rights: 原演讲受版权保护，本页仅提供本站编写的双语导读与来源链接。

blocks.en: Start with a shared resource: a fishery, forest, or irrigation system. How can users cooperate when each person's choices affect what remains available to others?
blocks.zh: 从一项共同使用的资源开始：渔场、森林，或者灌溉系统。当每个人的选择都影响别人还能使用多少资源时，使用者怎样合作？

blocks.en: Ostrom studies institutions built around real resources and communities. Rules, monitoring, enforcement, and local conditions help explain why similar-looking arrangements can have different outcomes.
blocks.zh: 奥斯特罗姆研究围绕真实资源与社群建立的制度。规则、监督、执行与地方条件，有助于解释为什么看起来相似的安排会产生不同结果。

blocks.en: Polycentric governance directs attention to multiple interacting centers of decision-making. The lecture invites comparison of institutional arrangements rather than reliance on one universal prescription.
blocks.zh: 多中心治理把注意力引向多个相互作用的决策中心。演讲邀请读者比较不同的制度安排，而不是依赖一种普遍适用的处方。

blocks.en: Reading question: who makes the rules, who checks compliance, and how can the rules change? Shared ownership alone does not answer these questions.
blocks.zh: 阅读时可以追问：谁制定规则，谁检查遵守情况，规则又怎样修改？仅仅说资源归大家共同所有，并不能回答这些问题。
